title: Smoke walk · ENH-231 Async Catch-Up (P0+P1 parity)
intro_html: Agent-verified at the DOM level — skim these, they're covered: the pills / done+stalled badges / worktree badges render; a file-chip click dispatches the open event; compact rows expand into cards; gone cards are grey + struck through; 2026 unit/component tests pass. The items below need your eyes + hands. CU-FOCUS is the one I genuinely couldn't test — my session runs OUTSIDE Duo (so it correctly shows as external/forks), so only you can confirm that a session running in a Duo terminal shows the green pill and focuses (not forks). First switch Home to Catch-up (the toggle at the top).

items.title: A Duo-hosted live session shows green ● live and FOCUSES (never forks)
items.what_fixes: The reported 'clicking a running session offered to fork it' was because that session ran OUTSIDE Duo. The fix: catch-up now shows green ● live (Duo-hosted → focus) vs amber ● running (external → fork), matching Projects Home. This step confirms the Duo-hosted path actually focuses.
steps: Have a `claude` session running in a DUO terminal tab (start one if needed; let it idle).
Switch Home to Catch-up. Find that session — it should be in the **Working** column with a green **● live** pill.
Click its **Focus session →** button.
PASS if it focuses/raises that terminal tab (no fork dialog). FAIL if it offers to fork or does nothing.

items.title: Done column = finished work (full) vs stalled (compact) — matches your mental model
items.what_fixes: Done used to mean 'merely inactive' (a junk drawer). Now full cards = a real deliverable (opened a PR, completed its TodoWrite plan, or produced a .md/.html doc) badged ✓ done; the compact 'Stalled · unfinished' rows beneath = closed with no deliverable, badged ⏸ stalled when expanded.
steps: In Catch-up, look at the **Done — review** column.
Confirm the full cards are sessions that actually finished something (PR / doc / completed todos), each with a **✓ done** badge.
Confirm the **Stalled · unfinished** compact rows beneath are sessions that just stopped (no PR/doc).
PASS if that split reads correctly to you; FAIL + note any card that's in the wrong tier.

items.title: A removed-worktree session is grey + struck through, reason on hover, no scary flag
items.what_fixes: Sessions from deleted worktrees can't resume (claude --resume dead-ends). Now the heading is just grey + struck through (no ⚠ flag, no dead-end button); hovering shows 'Worktree removed — <path> no longer exists'.
steps: In the Done column, find a card whose heading is grey + struck through (you have ~10).
Hover the struck heading — a tooltip should explain the worktree was removed.
Confirm there's NO loud ⚠ warning and NO re-entry button on it.
PASS if it reads as a quiet 'unavailable', not an alarm.

items.title: Clicking a file chip opens that file in Duo
items.what_fixes: Files-in-flight chips were inert; now they're buttons that open the file (parity with Projects Home's recent-file chips).
steps: Find a card with file chips (monospace filename chips under the todos).
Click one.
PASS if that file opens in Duo (editor/canvas); FAIL if nothing happens or the wrong file opens.

items.title: A compact (stalled) row expands into the full card, and collapses back
items.what_fixes: Owner request: collapsed rows need an expanded state mirroring the cards.
steps: Click a **Stalled · unfinished** compact row (under the Done column).
It should expand in place into the full card (goal · You asked · files · actions) with a **▾ collapse** control + a **⏸ stalled** badge.
Click **▾ collapse** — it returns to the one-line row.
PASS if expand + collapse both work.

items.title: Card previews are a clean 2-line gist — no raw markdown, no wall of text
items.what_fixes: The status / 'You asked' lines were dumping ```bash fences + the whole last turn. Now they're markdown-stripped + clamped to ~2 lines.
steps: Scan several cards' 'You asked' line and the italic status line.
Confirm no literal ``` fences / `**bold**` markers, and nothing runs past ~2 lines.
PASS if the previews read as clean gists.

items.title: A worktree session shows the repo + ⑂ slug badge
items.what_fixes: Two worktrees of one repo were indistinguishable (both showed the bare slug as the 'repo'). Now: repo label + a ⑂ <slug> badge.
steps: Find a card from a `.claude/worktrees/<slug>` session (most of yours).
Confirm the meta line shows the repo name (e.g. **duo**) AND a **⑂ <slug>** badge.
PASS if you can tell the repo from the worktree.

items.title: Dark theme — pills, badges, chips, gone-text all stay legible
items.what_fixes: Catch-up uses only var(--duo-*) tokens + the shared duo-banner-* classes, so it should flip cleanly. Theme-legibility is a recurring bug class — worth an eyes-on check in BOTH tones.
steps: Toggle Duo to dark mode (View ▸ Appearance, or `duo theme dark`).
Re-scan the board: the green/amber pills, ✓ done / ⏸ stalled badges, attention chips (question/blocked), file/todo chips, and the grey struck-through gone text.
PASS if everything is readable (no dark-on-dark / light-on-light); FAIL + name any illegible element. Then `duo theme light` to revert.

items.title: Projects ↔ Catch-up toggle persists across a Home reopen
items.what_fixes: App-global mode, remembered last-used, fanned out to all windows.
steps: Toggle to Catch-up, then click away to another tab and back to Home — it should still be on Catch-up.
Toggle to Projects — the old project view returns unchanged.
PASS if the choice sticks and both views render.
